title: Profit Redistribution in a TANK Model with Price and Wage Rigidities: An Analytical Benchmark and an Own-Lag Comparison
abstract: arXiv:2508.12073v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies profit redistribution in a Two-Agent New Keynesian model with price and wage rigidities, type-specific wages, and type-specific labor supply. An aggregate-lag benchmark yields closed-form distributional allocations and impact and infinite-horizon cumulative monetary-policy multipliers. The local effect of the hand-to-mouth share on impact multipliers requires an additional root condition; its local effect on infinite-horizon cumulative multipliers requires determinacy. The own-lag comparison holds primitive cost coefficients fixed rather than equating economic rigidity across timings. Across a grid of policy feedback, household wage-subsidy financing, household shares, and duration targets, expansionary monetary shocks raise output and inflation and lower profits. translated_title: 价格与工资刚性TANK模型中的利润再分配：一个分析基准与自身滞后比较
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一个具有价格和工资刚性、类型特定工资及类型特定劳动供给的两主体新凯恩斯模型中的利润再分配问题。一个总体滞后基准得出了闭式分配结果以及冲击和无限期累积货币政策乘数。手到嘴（hand-to-mouth）份额对冲击乘数的局部效应需要额外的根条件；其对无限期累积乘数的局部效应则需要确定性条件。自身滞后比较固定了原始成本系数，而非在不同时间安排下等同经济刚性。在政策反馈、家庭工资补贴融资、家庭份额和持续时间目标的网格中，扩张性货币冲击提高了产出和通胀，并降低了利润。手到嘴份额在两种时间安排下均增加了21个季度的累积响应，并在自身滞后调整下增加了冲击响应，而总体基准则不同。
tldr: 本文通过分析基准和自身滞后比较，揭示了价格与工资刚性TANK模型中利润再分配机制，并发现手到嘴份额显著影响货币政策乘数。
en_tdlr: This paper analytically and via own-lag comparison reveals profit redistribution in a TANK model with price and wage rigidities, showing that the hand-to-mouth share significantly amplifies monetary policy multipliers.
